chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Al-Umays, from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman, who said:
I saw Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) praying the two cycles of the obligatory Tawaf near the Maqam, close to the shade of the Masjid.

key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْ طَوَافِ الْفَرِيضَةِ: The two cycles of prayer for the obligatory circumambulation

ai.seo_question: Where did the Imam pray the two cycles of Tawaf prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the practice of Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) performing the two rak'ahs of Tawaf near the Maqam Ibrahim, a location traditionally associated with the Prophet Ibrahim and Ismail. This specific placement underscores the jurisprudential preference for praying close to the Station of Abraham, linking the ritual of circumambulation with the commemoration of monotheistic foundations. It serves as a key evidence for the recommended timing and spatial orientation of this specific prayer within Shia fiqh.
